column2: [intro]
In my thoughts, ideas are flying around,
Crazy notions, I’ve got them by the pound.
I wander through my wacky imagination,
And I think: "What a joy to be a bit of a sensation!"
In my head, it's a joyful mess,
A quirky world, it's anyone's guess.
I lose myself completely, but I love the way
The wild adventure in my mind is here to stay.
Sometimes, I create tales from afar,
Unicorns dancing on crying rainbows, bizarre.
I get lost in my dreams, so utterly strange,
And I think: "Reality is much less deranged!"
In my head, it's a real safari,
Monkeys dance, and elephants are merry.
Ideas clash, it’s a chaotic delight,
But it’s always more fun than being formal and tight.
[ solo ]
So join me in my wild mental spree,
Where normality has no place, it's free.
For losing yourself in your head and finding it cool,
That’s the extravagant world of my superfun pop rule!
[outro]
